newsitem.title: USA: Campbell Soup puts soup in glass jars.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Soup puts soup in glass jars.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co said on Wednesday it would bring out four new ready-to-serve soups in glass jars.

The soups -- Chicken & Pasta with Garden Vegetables, Garden Vegetables with Pasta, Cream of Mushroom and Minestrone -- would be introduced nationally this week and available in supermarkets in the fall, the company said in a statement.
They marked the company's first premium entry into the $2.4 billion wet soup category, Campbell said.
The line would be backed by one of the largest advertising and marketing programs in company history, it said.
Television ads would accompany a massive in-store sampling program, Campbell said.

"Other established categories that have had premium innovations have seen dramatic incremental category growth, such as spaghetti sauce, gravies and new age teas," Daniel O'Neill, Presidnet of Campbell's U.S. soup division said in a statement.
"We ask consumers to design their ideal soup and we then developed a beteer, fresher-tasting soup in a vacuum-packed, resealable glass jar," O'Neill said.
The new soups would be line priced with a suggested retail price of $2.39 a jar, Campbell said.
